goal: Add robust automated tests: unit, integration, socket tests, and E2E Playwright smoke tests validating the complete driver workflow.

tasks.title: Unit tests for schemas and utilities
steps: Set up Vitest config
Create unit tests for all Zod schemas (valid + invalid cases per field constraint)
Create unit tests for /lib/haversine.ts (known coordinate pairs, edge cases)
Create unit tests for /lib/rate-limit.ts (window enforcement + reset)

tasks.title: Integration tests for API routes
steps: Provision isolated test PostgreSQL database for CI/local
Run Drizzle migrations before tests
Write integration tests for: register, login, /users/me, drivers/location, drivers/nearby, stress endpoints, voice endpoints
Assert correct status codes, ownership checks, and error shapes
verification: npm run test passes integration suite

tasks.title: Socket.io integration tests
steps: Use socket.io-client in tests
Test authenticated socket connect success and unauthenticated rejection
Test Zod validation rejection for bad payloads
Test update_location -> nearby_driver_update behavior
Test send_voice_message -> voice_message_received
Test send_stress_signal -> stress_signal_alert

tasks.title: Playwright E2E smoke tests
steps: Set up Playwright config
Write E2E flow: register -> login -> map -> send voice -> trigger stress -> verify alerts
Run against local server + test DB
Avoid brittle selectors; use role-based selectors
verification: npm run test:e2e passes on clean run

tasks.title: Coverage reporting and thresholds
steps: Enable coverage reporting in Vitest
Target >= 80% for /lib, /sockets/handlers, /app/api
Fail CI if below threshold
verification: Coverage threshold is met and enforced

must_provide: How to run with test DB

integration_checkpoint.name: Checkpoint G — QA Gate
must_pass: npm run test passes (unit + integration + sockets)
No unhandled promise rejections or console errors during tests

stop_condition_to_advance: All automated tests pass reliably and coverage thresholds are enforced.
